response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack engineer with deep expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, and Dlang, but he fundamentally lacks the core requirements for this position. He does not possess the mandatory 5 to 10 years of C++ development experience on Windows, nor does he have the required Capital Markets or Fixed Income domain expertise.
strengths: Over 15 years of versatile software engineering experience across full-stack, web, and microservices architectures.
Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps infrastructure, and test-driven development.
Excellent communication abilities demonstrated through technical talks, workshops, and open-source leadership.
concerns: Falls severely short of the mandatory 5-10 years of C++ experience, showing only 7 months of professional C/C++ work in 2014-2015.
Lacks required domain expertise in Capital Markets, Fixed Income, or Investment Banking.
Missing strong SQL Server or Oracle experience, with recent roles leaning heavily on MongoDB and GraphQL.
